scope: Six servings of traditional white milk sauce. 500g weighed whole milk, 35g butter, 35g wheat flour, 3g salt, 0.4g white pepper and 0.2g nutmeg. No ingredient solids discarded; water evaporation not treated as nutrient loss. Tiny spices bounded as source-limited omissions, not zero. Editorial nutrition estimate.
